authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI generation artifacts. While the upper bodies and heads of the giraffes are rendered with reasonable detail, the lower legs show severe fusion and melting into the grass, lacking distinct hooves and anatomical separation. The suitcases also display structural inconsistencies, with handles and edges appearing warped or fused. The lighting is uniform but the textures on the suitcases lack realistic wear. The overall composition feels synthetic due to the repetitive posing and anatomical failures in the limbs.
